review_evidence: src/CCL/CCL.thy: typedecl i, axiomatizations of evaluation and case rules (trueV, caseV*, caseB*, po_refl, eq_iff), definitions fix, SIM, POgen, EQgen, PO, EQ, Dvg, Trm, lemmas poXH, eqXH, po_coinduct, eq_coinduct3, exhaustion, term_case, plus ML tactic setup.
src/CCL/Fix.thy: definition idgen, axiomatization INCL, lemmas fix_ind, term_ind and reachability results.
src/CCL/Gfp.thy: definition gfp, lemmas gfp_Tarski, coinduct, coinduct2, coinduct3, gfp_mono.
src/CCL/Lfp.thy: definition lfp, lemmas lfp_Tarski, induct, def_induct, lfp_mono.
src/CCL/Hered.thy: definitions HTTgen and HTT (hereditary termination), lemmas HTTXH, HTT_coinduct3, and NatF, ListF, ListsF, IListsF.

src/CCL/Set.thy: typedecl 'a set, axiomatization of Collect and mem, definitions Ball, Bex, subset, mono, singleton, empty, Un, Int, Compl, INTER, UNION, Inter, Union, and about 100 lemmas (subset_antisym, Un_Int_distrib, Compl_UN, Union_least, Inter_greatest, mono_Un, Un_mono and others) with proofs.

src/CCL/Term.thy: 23 definitions of program constructs (if, inl, inr, split, when, fst, snd, thd, zero, succ, ncase, let1, letrec, letrec2, letrec3, nrec, nil, cons, lcase, lrec, napply), parse and print translations, beta rules (letB, fixB, letrecB, nrecBsucc, lrecBcons and others), term_injs, term_porews.
src/CCL/Trancl.thy: definitions trans, id, relcomp, rtrancl, trancl, with lemmas on reflexive-transitive and transitive closure.
src/CCL/Type.thy: type definitions Subtype, Unit, Bool, Plus, Pi, Sigma, Nat, List, Lists, ILists, TAll, TEx, Lift, SPLIT, with lemmas Nat_ind, List_ind, POgenIs, EQgenIs.

src/CCL/Wfd.thy: definitions Wfd, wf, wmap, lex, NatPR, ListPR, lemmas wfd_induct, lex_wf, letrecT, hyprcall3T, rmIH1-3, Subtype_canTs, letT, applyT2, typechk/clean_ccs/gen_ccs/eval method setup, evaluation lemmas applyV, letV, fixV, letrecV, V_rls, and 8 schematic_goal evaluation examples (factorial, less-or-equal, reverse).

src/CCL/ex/Flag.thy: Dutch national flag program: definitions Colour, red, white, blue, ccase, flag, Flag, axiomatization Perm, lemmas ColourXH, redT, whiteT, blueT, ccaseT, and a typing lemma for flag.

src/CCL/ex/List.thy: definitions map, comp, append, filter, flat, partition, insert, isort, qsort, axiomatization member, lemmas listBs, nmapBnil, nmapBcons, mapT, appendT, filterT, flatT, insertT, partitionT.
src/CCL/ex/Nat.thy: definitions not, add, mult, sub, le, lt, div, ackermann, lemmas natBs, napply_f, addT, multT, subT, leT, ltT, and the typing (termination) lemma for Ackermann's function.
src/CCL/ex/Stream.thy: definitions iter1, iter2, coinductive lemmas map_comp, map_id, map_append, append_assoc, ilist_append, iter1B, iter2B, iter2Blemma, iter1_iter2_eq.
summary: Read all 14 listed files of Isabelle CCL (Classical Computational Logic) completely: 10 core theories (CCL, Fix, Gfp, Hered, Lfp, Set, Term, Trancl, Type, Wfd) and 4 example theories (ex/Flag, ex/List, ex/Nat, ex/Stream). Every file holds its own formal definitions, axiomatizations, lemmas with proofs, or proof-method setup. No file is an import-only aggregator, and no file duplicates another indexed file. All 14 files stay in the primary index; no exclusions.
